stem:
Varun compares a small steel spoon and a large foam packing block. On a balance, the spoon is heavier than the foam block.

What can he correctly conclude about mass?

options.text: The spoon has more mass than the foam block.
The spoon has more volume than the foam block because it is heavier.
The spoon has less mass than the foam block even though it is heavier on the balance.
He cannot compare their masses on the balance.

teacher.key_rationale: Heavier on the balance means greater mass: the spoon has more mass than the foam block.
